instruction: The last flip-flops I bought on Amazon is a bit too small for me. Initiate a return for it, and buy a replacement of the same in the next larger size. If it's available now in red, prefer it, otherwise go with the same color.
notes: Single-app Amazon task plus supervisor. Knowledge chain: show_product_purchases discovers the last flip-flops purchase (order, product); show_order yields the ordered quantity for the return; show_product (no token) reveals the size/color variations and binds the replacement (next larger size, red preferred else same color) as a runtime selection rule, since the red-availability branch cannot be known in :init; show_return_deliverers supplies a deliverer id. initiate_return records the return; add_product_to_cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true then place_order (card/address discovered via show_payment_cards/show_addresses) creates exactly one new order with a single item of quantity 1. Return and cart quantities use distinct types so the planner cannot confuse the literal 1 with the runtime ordered quantity. supervisor-complete-task takes the task records (order, returned product, replacement, quantity) as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal; no answer is passed since the task is not a question.
